description: Hanabishi Miki (Hayate the Combat Butler) as a drawing reference: a 1.51 m anime schoolgirl (5.9 heads) in a relaxed A-pose, standing at the origin on the ground (z = 0) and facing -Y (her left hand on +X). 17 mesh objects, each a spatially compact group of parts (hair, head, eyes, headband, scarf, sidelocks, blouse, collar, back_hair, arm_l, face_marks, arm_r, legs, socks, skirt, shoes, ring) so hidden-line removal stays fast; colours are per-part materials in examples/meshes/miki.obj/.mtl/.glb. Smooth groups turn the designed lines (bang cut, headband, collar, cuffs, hems) into feature edges and leave the rest to silhouettes. In the web UI choose it from the Example menu, orbit the board around her (the front button looks along +y at her face) and untick the 'labels' layer: every mesh vertex is labelled. CLI: 'castplane render examples/miki.json -o out'. Generated by tools/make_miki_model.py.
